topic: What if Earth were flat? It could not happen: gravity pulls a planet-sized mass into a ball.

episode.title: What If Earth Were Flat?

shots.scene: Colourful 3D science lab, vertical frame, blank hologram platform between Nova and Byte, no text.
shots.action: Nova reveals a glowing disk-shaped Earth hologram.
shots.mood: Bright turquoise light, playful curiosity, exaggerated surprised robot eyes.

shots.narration: A planet-sized disk couldn't stay flat under its own gravity.
shots.scene: Colourful lab with an unstable disk-shaped Earth hologram, no text.
shots.mood: Intriguing and energetic, warm lab lighting, rippling blue glow.

shots.scene: Lab hologram showing separated rocky fragments against a dark blue backdrop, no text.
shots.action: The rocky fragments gather into a clump.
shots.mood: Clear and wondrous, bright golden highlights on floating rocks.

shots.narration: With enough mass, that pull overcomes rock's strength.
shots.scene: Colourful lab with a large irregular rocky world hologram, no text.
shots.action: The rocky world's tallest protrusion sinks into its bulk.
shots.mood: Fascinating and calm, glowing orange seams beneath grey rock.

shots.narration: So our imaginary flat Earth would collapse inward.
shots.scene: Lab with a restored disk-shaped Earth hologram above the platform, no people on its surface, no text.
shots.action: The disk collapses into a compact rounded mass.
shots.mood: Spectacular but reassuring, colourful flowing material, soft blue illumination.

shots.narration: [surprised] Gravity would reshape it into a roughly spherical planet.
shots.scene: Colourful lab with a lumpy planetary hologram, no text.
shots.action: The holographic planet settles into a sphere.
shots.mood: Satisfying transformation, luminous blues and greens, delighted robot eyes.

shots.narration: Mountains can remain, but they're tiny compared with Earth.
shots.scene: Lab hologram showing a curved Earth horizon with rugged mountains, no text.
shots.action: The holographic view zooms out until the mountains become barely visible.
shots.mood: Wonder at scale, crisp rocky detail fading into a smooth blue globe.

shots.narration: Earth isn't perfectly spherical, but it certainly isn't flat.
shots.scene: Colourful lab with a realistic Earth hologram, subtly wider around its equator, no text.
shots.action: Nova traces the planet's curved outline with one finger.
shots.mood: Cheerful discovery, bright ocean colours, soft white clouds.

shots.narration: [excited] Gravity rounds stars, too! What if Earth had no Moon?
shots.scene: Colourful lab with a spherical golden star hologram beside a smaller Earth and Moon hologram, no text.
shots.mood: Surprising and inviting, golden starlight beside a mysterious blue Earth.

episode.endHook: What if Earth had no Moon?
episode.description: What if Earth were flat? Dr. Nova shows Byte why gravity prevents a planet-sized disk from staying flat—and why planets become round.
